name: AI Video Analytics
description: Sample dashboard for AI video platform metrics.

native.query: SELECT metric_date, total_tasks, successful_tasks, failed_tasks, success_rate FROM analytics.mart_task_metrics ORDER BY metric_date
SELECT metric_date, avg_duration_seconds, median_duration_seconds FROM analytics.mart_task_metrics ORDER BY metric_date
SELECT metric_date, credits_consumed, credits_granted, net_credits_consumed FROM analytics.mart_credit_metrics ORDER BY metric_date
SELECT metric_date, dau, new_users FROM analytics.mart_user_metrics ORDER BY metric_date
SELECT metric_date, total_tasks, total_credits_consumed, cost_per_task FROM analytics.mart_cost_per_task ORDER BY metric_date

SELECT model_id, count() AS tasks, countIf(is_success = 1) AS successful, avgIf(turnaround_seconds, is_success = 1) AS avg_duration_seconds FROM analytics.fct_tasks GROUP BY model_id ORDER BY tasks DESC
